/assets/miscellaneous/meritInfo.json.name: Merit Wallet
/assets/miscellaneous/meritInfo.json.description: Merit Wallet is SponsorCoin's built-in wallet and trading hub — it manages your active account, connected network, and wallet sources (MetaMask, Hardhat, and locally-held accounts) from one docked panel, organized into five tabs:

tabs.label: Exchange Tokens
tabs.detail: Trade any supported token for another through the 0x aggregator, with live pricing and adjustable slippage tolerance.

tabs.label: Send Tokens
tabs.detail: Transfer a token or spCoin directly to another account by address, from the active wallet account.

tabs.label: Add Sponsorship
tabs.detail: Stake spCoin to sponsor a recipient — optionally routed through an agent — to begin accruing sponsorship rewards.

tabs.label: Sponsorship Staking Rewards Manager
tabs.detail: View and claim rewards accrued as a sponsor, recipient, or agent, and manage currently active sponsorships.

tabs.label: App Configurator
tabs.detail: Adjust trade slippage and other wallet-level settings for the app.
